title: Historical Corpus of the Welsh Language, 1500-1850 (HCWL; Corpws Hanesyddol yr Iaith Gymraeg)
notes: HCWL 1500-1850 is a ~420,000-word TEI-XML corpus of 30 Welsh texts (incl. Y Beibl Cyssegr-lan 1588, A study of three Welsh religious plays, Report on Manuscripts in the Welsh Language...) built at Cambridge c. 2004, hosted at celticstudies.net (which the harvest used as mirror; 'HCWL celticstudies.net mirror -> b1588.xml', bll.xml, cardiff6.xml etc. are the corpus's XML master files); a parsed derivative (PARSHCWL) and a LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ deposit (LRT-883) also exist. Site copyright 2004, University of Cambridge; effectively archived. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: University of Cambridge, Linguistics Dept. (David Willis)
